name: Accept Crypto Donations
author: dovsherman

sections.description:
Accept Crypto Donations by DigiDov is the easiest way for charities to accept cryptocurrency donations with instant IRS-compliant tax receipts. 100% FREE to use with professional-grade compliance and security.

Key Features

  • FREE to use – No setup fees, monthly fees, or subscription costs
  • 100% Non-custodial – We NEVER hold your funds, they go directly to YOUR wallet
  • Instant IRS-compliant tax receipts – Fully automated for donors
  • Hold crypto OR convert to dollars – Instant bank transfer available
  • Professional dashboard – Real-time donation tracking and analytics
  • You keep 97% – Only 3% platform fee, competitive with traditional processors

How It Works

  1. Sign up FREE at DigiDov.com – wallet created automatically
  2. Copy your donation link from your DigiDov dashboard
  3. Paste the link in WordPress Admin → Accept Crypto Donations settings
  4. Add donation button using [donate-crypto] shortcode anywhere on your site
  5. Start accepting crypto – donors get instant IRS-compliant tax receipts

Why Choose DigiDov?

  • 🔒 100% Non-custodial – Your funds, your control. We can’t access them.
  • 📋 IRS Compliance – Instant tax-compliant receipts for all donors
  • 💵 Flexibility – Hold Ethereum or convert to dollars with instant bank transfer
  • ⛓️ On-chain Only – No credit cards, no traditional payment processing hassles
  • 🆓 Completely FREE – No setup fees, monthly fees, or subscription costs
  • 🏦 No Merchant Accounts – Skip the payment processor complexity

Shortcodes

  • [donate-crypto] – Displays the crypto donation button (recommended)
  • [give-nfts] – Legacy shortcode (still supported)

Support

Visit DigiDov.com for support and to create your FREE account.

Accept crypto donations like cash – hold it or convert to dollars instantly.
